name: 103-robust-pause-in-error-then-recover
description: Robustness: segment 3 takes 300 ms and fails twice (about 0.3 s and 2.6 s after load; the try 4 s later succeeds, about 6.9 s after load); the playhead runs dry at the end of 2 (Error). The listener pauses during the Error; when 3 arrives the player must stay Paused (not start playing on its own), and play then resumes in 3.
